name: A Growing Adventure: Prologue
source:
The story takes place in a fantasy game world, and our main character wakes up in a forest at level 1 with amnesia, a dick, and an ability called "Leveled Growth".
[Source: Itch.io]
translation:
故事发生在一个奇幻游戏世界中，我们的主角在一级森林中醒来，患有失忆症、鸡鸡和一种名为“等级成长”的能力。
[来源：Itch.io]
